description: Crichton's growing bond with Moya's crew is tested by political traps, mind games and Scorpius's neural technology, culminating in an audacious campaign to rescue D'Argo's son and the devastating consequences of the chip inside Crichton's mind.

s02e01.description: Crichton and the others struggle to reunite after the previous battle while Crais and the young gunship Talyn force Aeryn into a dangerous standoff.

s02e02.description: D'Argo agrees to help an aged Luxan priestess complete a sacred death ritual, only to discover that the ceremony is draining life from Moya.

s02e03.description: Grieving her brother, Chiana joins reckless youths on a death-obsessed world and pushes herself toward a lethal rite of passage.

s02e04.description: A strange light source drives Moya's crew into escalating paranoia and hostility until Crichton must determine what is manipulating everyone.

s02e05.description: An old Peacekeeper recording reveals Aeryn's part in Moya's capture and the brutal circumstances that brought Pilot aboard.

s02e06.description: A mysterious portrait begins predicting death and swallowing members of the crew, forcing them to confront a supernatural threat they cannot simply shoot.

s02e07.description: Desperate for food, Moya visits a mining settlement where workers are being killed by a creature and Zhaan's survival becomes tied to the colony.

s02e08.description: Zhaan recounts how she was accused of murder on a world where legal proceedings are entertainment and the truth is almost beside the point.

s02e09.description: An energy discharge swaps the crew into one another's bodies, leaving them to survive an attack while learning far too much about their companions.

s02e10.description: An alien probe splits Crichton into primitive, present and hyper-evolved versions, forcing the crew to decide which version has the right to live.

s02e11.description: Crichton is drawn into a royal marriage meant to preserve a dynasty, while Scorpius turns the ceremony into another route to his wormhole knowledge.

s02e12.description: Political enemies sabotage Crichton's arranged marriage and trap him in a long-term living-statue state while the crew works to keep him alive.

s02e13.description: Crichton's restoration from stone triggers one last round of palace intrigue, assassination attempts and bargaining with Scorpius before the royal crisis can end.

s02e14.description: The crew brings aboard a seemingly useful creature to hunt a parasite, then discovers that the supposed solution may be the real predator.

s02e15.description: Crichton is trapped inside an elaborate imitation of Earth designed to break him psychologically and extract the secrets buried in his mind.

s02e16.description: A temporal anomaly strands Aeryn and Crichton on a world where decades pass in moments, testing whether their relationship can survive an entire lifetime.

s02e17.description: After Talyn destroys another ship, the crew is interrogated separately and each account of the incident exposes different loyalties and assumptions.

s02e18.description: Nebari agents board Moya and begin cleansing the crew's minds, forcing Chiana to confront the society she escaped and the fate of her brother.

s02e19.description: To rescue D'Argo's son, the crew plans an audacious robbery of a shadow depository and gathers a collection of dangerous former enemies as reluctant allies.

s02e20.description: The depository raid succeeds only partly, forcing Crichton's improvised alliance to fight its way through Scorpius's trap with stolen weapons and unstable partners.

s02e21.description: The rescue becomes an all-out assault as Crichton gambles everything against Scorpius to free Jothee and get Moya's people out alive.

s02e22.description: Scorpius's neural chip takes control of Crichton, driving him against his own crew and ending in a devastating confrontation with Aeryn.
